description: This PHP source file defines a view component for the Opportunities subpanel in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It primarily constructs an HTML form with buttons for creating new opportunities and selecting existing ones, and initializes a list view for displaying related opportunity records within the subpanel.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in the CRM, including initialization with templates, setting headers, and processing data for display.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new XTemplate with a specified template file and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the XTemplate for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the header text or HTML content for the list view's header.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with the given data and template.
